findings.text: the declared mutation RECKON_COMPLETE_SKIP_HEAD_CHECK=1 patches reckon.cli._refuse_a_plain_complete_off_the_branch, which reckon/cli.py does not import and whose crew_complete resolves the name in reckon.crew_run_commands, so the helper raises AttributeError instead of removing the guard; running the unmerged-head test at the reviewed head with that variable set fails at tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py:56 with that AttributeError, so the manifest's rubric.durability and the fragment's 'the declared mutation removes the guard' claim a falsification control that does not work

adding refusal family D25 leaves the refusal census red: tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py:33 builds CONVERTED_REFUSAL_FAMILIES from range(1, 25), so tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py::test_the_dispatch_refusal_census_is_partitioned_without_gaps fails at the head with 'Extra items in the left set: D25' until the sibling node owning that file extends the range; the node records this under outside_scope, and the coordinator must sequence that repair rather than landing this change alone

item_verdicts.call_sites: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3235 (crew_complete), reckon/crew/merge.py:790 (_push_and_confirm through _remote_head), and reckon/crew/promotion.py:1442 which resolves the same promoted revision the guard checks.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against fb8c7733b6: 94279c6c70 adds merge._read_remote_head/head_on_remote_branch, the D25 remedy and the plain-complete guard; c1cbdb3d52 adds only the evidence fragment; 737 insertions, 3 deletions across 5 files.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py over a temporary repository and bare origin; the manifest records that gate's base arm (6 failed, 4 passed) and head arm (10 passed) with logs under the run directory.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that a plain passed complete refuses an implementation head off the remote primary branch; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3234-3237 and 3388-3393 implement exactly that refusal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and both arms, the negative-control log path, the declared mutation, and records the refusal-census failure under outside_scope.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/merge.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, reckon/crew/refusals.py, the new test and the evidence fragment; the diff touches exactly those five files.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py::test_a_plain_complete_on_an_unmerged_head_refuses_and_leaves_the_run fails at the base revision and passes at the head, but the declared mutation RECKON_COMPLETE_SKIP_HEAD_CHECK=1 patches a name reckon/cli.py does not carry and raises AttributeError instead of removing the guard (verified here at head).
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py covers every arm the done_when names, and the manifest records the base arm at 6 failed/4 passed and the head arm at 10 passed under logs/ with EXIT lines; the negative-control log shows the base revision promoting with ok true and pointer_removed true.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/merge.py:662 extends the module's own remote-read and ancestry idiom, and no added name carries a plan, stage or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3234-3237 calls _refuse_a_plain_complete_off_the_branch before promotion for a non-land, passed-gate run, and its D25 message names the reviewed head and origin/main.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/merge.py:619 extends the existing _remote_head read and reckon/crew/merge.py:662 composes _is_ancestor, _rev_parse and the port-443 helpers; a search over reckon for ls-remote and ancestry owners found no other capability that answers this question.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/merge.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, reckon/crew/refusals.py, the new test and the evidence fragment) is inside the declared write paths, and nothing else changed.
